lane.name: Overlay Evidence Contract
lane.reason: Run beside the existing screenshot/settings fleet while the same evidence fields are emitted by browser review and the production browser/localhost model factory. Product regressions stay red; missing evidence plumbing should not be the reason.

currentFramework.primarySignal: artifact, screenshot manifest, route, and selected model-field assertions
strengths: proves screenshot generation and route coverage exists
catches final layout, clipping, text-fit, and pixel-level regressions
keeps known V1.0.2/V1.0.3 findings tied to source files and generated artifacts
can compare browser, localhost, and native manifests after screenshots exist
blindSpots: presence of a model or screenshot can pass without proving semantic parity
row counts can pass while row identity, placeholder rows, and clipped rows differ
fixture previews can look live unless provenance is explicit
localhost/browser/native settings can drift unless shared fingerprints are compared before render
unavailable states can carry stale graph/table/input content without a policy field
visual parity failures arrive late and can hide data-contract failures underneath

evidenceContractFramework.primarySignal: normalized semantic evidence contract emitted or inferred before pixels
strengths: fails before screenshot generation when the data contract is already insufficient
compares settings fingerprints, route identity, provenance, and runtime evidence as first-class fields
asserts both required and forbidden text/data
treats tables as row and column identity instead of row count
separates live-capture, synthetic-preview, stale-history, and unavailable evidence
keeps screenshot tests focused on pixel/layout proof after semantic correctness is established
primaryAssertions: browserReview, localhostObs, and windowsNative settings fingerprints exist and match
browser and localhost route paths are explicit
native pixel evidence is captured or explicitly unsupported/disabled
preview provenance declares evidence class, source contract, and capture specificity
table overlays expose column keys, row identities, and placeholder counts
unavailable states suppress stale rendered content unless marked stale-history or section-aware placeholder evidence
fuel success copy requires measured additional-fuel-need evidence
metric overlays expose content density and unused-height ratios
fallback/synthetic states are labelled separately from live capture

detectionMatrix.currentFramework: screenshot validators can catch missing files after artifact generation
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: runtime surface evidence requires captured/disabled/unsupported pixel status and reason before parity is accepted
detectionMatrix.improvement: turns missing pixels into explicit evidence quality instead of an absent artifact

detectionMatrix.failureClass: synthetic previews mistaken for capture evidence
detectionMatrix.currentFramework: scenario manifests mention source files but do not make evidence class the main assertion
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: provenance requires evidenceClass, captureSpecific, sourceContract, and syntheticStateKind where applicable
detectionMatrix.improvement: separates fixture proof from live capture proof

detectionMatrix.currentFramework: can catch once screenshot/model manifest includes title
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: fails directly on title/renderedTitle/visibleText before pixels
detectionMatrix.improvement: moves chrome contract to data/model layer

detectionMatrix.currentFramework: settings-effect tests assert selected values but do not provide one normalized parity object
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: sharedSettingsHash and overlaySettingsHash are required for every runtime surface and compared as one fingerprint
detectionMatrix.improvement: catches browser/localhost/native divergence even when all three render something plausible

detectionMatrix.failureClass: table count passes while row identity drifts
detectionMatrix.currentFramework: row count and screenshot parity can miss placeholder/clipped identity mismatches
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: columnKeys, rowIdentities, and placeholderRowCount are mandatory table evidence
detectionMatrix.improvement: tests the table contract users actually see

detectionMatrix.failureClass: standings clipped rows and absurd intervals
detectionMatrix.currentFramework: screenshot validators can see clipping only after a generated artifact exists
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: tableStatus and timingSanity are required semantic evidence

detectionMatrix.failureClass: fuel and pit collapsed-content oversized shells
detectionMatrix.currentFramework: pixel checks detect oversized shells late
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: layout.contentRowCount and layout.unusedHeightRatio are required model evidence
detectionMatrix.improvement: turns visual emptiness into an auditable model contract

detectionMatrix.failureClass: input preview unavailable despite fixture controls
detectionMatrix.currentFramework: screenshot may show waiting UI but not prove fixture controls existed
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: inputAvailability.fixtureControlsAvailable and non-empty trace evidence are required
detectionMatrix.improvement: distinguishes unavailable data from lost mapping

detectionMatrix.currentFramework: graph pixels can exist without proving whether they are stale
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: unavailable rendered content requires suppress-rendered-content, section-aware placeholders, or stale-history provenance
detectionMatrix.improvement: prevents stale-looking data from masquerading as unavailable truth

detectionMatrix.currentFramework: vector manifest may show circle geometry but status can still say live
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: circle mapKind requires mapFallback provenance and cannot be live-labelled
detectionMatrix.improvement: separates fallback geometry from a real readable map

detectionMatrix.currentFramework: diagnostic tests can inspect sidecar metadata after bundle creation
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: future capture contracts should attach sidecar identity to provenance before overlay evidence is trusted
detectionMatrix.improvement: connects source identity to overlay proof

detectionMatrix.failureClass: localhost route evidence is only request stats
detectionMatrix.currentFramework: localhost request stats can pass without per-overlay render proof
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: localhostObs.routePath is required per overlay and compared alongside runtime settings evidence

detectionMatrix.currentFramework: catalogue tests can expose route presence but not native/browser/localhost support status
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: every supported overlay declares runtime surface evidence or an unsupported reason
detectionMatrix.improvement: forces first-class support decisions into the contract

detectionMatrix.failureClass: diagnostic sample frames miss race phase
detectionMatrix.currentFramework: aggregate diagnostics can pass while concrete samples come from the wrong session phase
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: future capture contracts should require per-session sample provenance before aggregates prove overlay behavior
detectionMatrix.improvement: moves aggregate/sample alignment into evidence quality

detectionMatrix.failureClass: flags, radar, and stream chat synthetic provenance
detectionMatrix.currentFramework: fixture states can be useful but ambiguous
detectionMatrix.evidenceContract: syntheticStateKind is required for forced or suppressed-state fixtures
detectionMatrix.improvement: prevents demo states from being counted as live evidence
